schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: STAGE 1 OF THE CHART CHAIN, and a machine of its own since 2026-08-13. It answers ONE narrow question — what is actually being asked, and where does it live? — and emits the smallest typed artifact that fully determines what the next stage needs. The floor does not scan the territory itself: it COMPOSES cairn/tools/orient's device_census, so the roster is the settled measurer's, never a parallel scan. Emits the orient packet (intent/domain/scope/refs/unknowns) and refuses any ref the floor cannot verify EXISTS. Three strata, cheapest first: FLOOR (deterministic, this module), TREE (this nexus's own corpus through cairn/tools/tree), CEILING (the skill's assembly). The exit artifact berths in instance-space and the deposit-back lands it as the tree's memory of this class of request.
why: Akien, verbatim 2026-08-13: "orient is a machine. the other pre-build steps are each their own machine." A machine is tools plus the glue that holds them together, and that is exactly the shape here: cairn/tools/chain's grammar plus this stage's own question. THE LIVED SYMPTOM the whole chain answers is a build that starts before anyone settled what was being built — the web-server carrier miss (2026-07-28), bounds-checking that never ran to completion. A stage that is its own machine can be fired, proved, and replaced alone; one that is a function in a 1,300-line module cannot. WHY THE RECORD AND NOT A COMPLAINT LIST (Akien, 2026-08-13): "passing such a thing without inspecting it means passing a mystery if something downstream fails … if every machine and even some more complex tools have their own inspector and gate, then each has documented and controllable quality validation … we can backtrack and see exactly where something went awry even if it's not something we're specifically looking for yet." A complaint list is empty both when every check passed and when no check ran, so the stage downstream is handed a mystery in exactly the case he named. The entries that PASSED are the ones nobody was looking for. "We might have to add more or better inspection questions, but that's fine. we learn as we go" — so the question list grows, and every addition is one more entry a reader sees whether it passed or failed.

feedback.why: STAGE 1 IS THE ONLY LEG WITH NO UPSTREAM STAGE, and that is measured, not assumed: 2026-08-14 every other leg's inspector opens on a ref into the berth before it (constrain reads intent_ref, survey constrain_ref, decompose survey_ref, triage decompose_ref, hypothesize triage_ref, validate hypothesize_ref, verdict validate_ref) and orient's opens on none. Orient's input is the ASK itself, so the upstream creative entity is where an ask is born, and CLAUDE.md names that address: every node birth is at /intent. Akien's rule for the -2- edge, 2026-08-14, verbatim: "the purpose of an inspector/gate combination is to qa THE OUTPUT OF THE THING BEFORE IT THATS COMING IN AS ITS INPUT. IF IT FAILS, GENERALLY THAT FEEDBACK GOES BACK TO THE UPSTREAM CREATIVE ENTITY. In some cases it skips levels." This is his skip-to-intention case — 'it might even go back to intention' — and it is the one his own measurement found dominant: of askscan's five gaps, three were ambiguities in the REQUEST and belonged above the whole chain. WHAT THIS ROUTE SERVES: every_ref_exists_on_disk failing means the ask carried a name nobody could resolve, and authored_fields_are_non_empty_strings failing means it carried too little to orient on — both are facts about the request, and both are actionable at /intent. WHAT IT DOES NOT REACH: the /chart ceiling that filled the packet is a hand, and a hand is not an address (the same limit tools/feedback names for itself).

invoke: fired by the skill that runs the chain; the writer door is write_packet; the inspector is inspect_orient(packet) and returns the proof record without taking a verdict, so a caller can READ what this stage proved without provoking its refusal
entry: Carved out of the chart machine on 2026-08-13 under Akien's ruling — "chart is a skill, it calls a collection of machines. that's the intention." The chart charter it was carved from is the design record of the whole chain and now berths with the skill at cairn/skills/chart/intention+why.json; this file holds only what is THIS component's.
state_and_history: state.json + history.json beside this charter. Both were born at the carve-out: the voyages that built this stage are recorded in the chart machine's history, which stays whole with the skill — a record of truth is never split (Law 7).
gates: THE STAGE'S OWN INSPECTOR AND ITS OWN GATE, at this address (ruling 2026-08-13 every-machine-carries-its-own-inspector-and-gate). ``inspect_orient`` returns a PROOF RECORD — one entry per check that ran, EXPECTED beside ACTUAL, passes included — and ``validate_orient`` is the == compare over it, per entry, with no oracle anywhere near it. The shared half of the record comes from cairn/tools/chain's ``common_shape_record`` so the eight doors cannot drift apart; the stage-specific half is written here. Refusals still name every shape lack at once (ticket chart-doors-refuse-in-one-pass), and they are DERIVED from the record's mismatches, so the gate and the sentence it prints cannot disagree about what failed. A CHECK THAT DID NOT RUN IS ABSENT, NOT PASSED: guarded checks make the record SHORTER, never cleaner.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) this stage reading its input from anywhere but the previous stage's BERTHED packet; (2) a door that dribbles refusals instead of naming every lack in one pass; (3) a packet admitted whose provenance does not cover every authored field; (4) this module importing a sibling stage — the legs speak the grammar, never each other. (5) a check in this stage's inspector that PASSES SILENTLY — every check that ran appears in the record with its EXPECTED beside its ACTUAL, and a check that could not run is ABSENT rather than passed, so a check that stops running makes the record SHORTER and never cleaner; (6) a refusal sentence assembled from anywhere but the record's own mismatches — the gate and the sentence it prints cannot be allowed to disagree about what failed; (7) an oracle consulted anywhere on this path, at fire time or at sleep — `bin/cmd/determinism` must keep reading this component PURE DETERMINISTIC and REFUSES GATE.
horizon: re-read when the chain's stage list changes, or when this stage's tree stratum goes live against a real embed seam.
how_it_learns: the deposit-back: every ceiling assembly deposits its own answer into this nexus's tree, so the next similar request walks to a settled answer instead of re-deriving it (Law 1 as runtime). The dial (cairn/skills/chart/dial.py) is the instrument that says whether the floor+tree fraction is actually growing — a nexus that never compiles is a ceiling doing the floor's job forever.
traces_to: Law 1 (the preamble compiled; the resolver spent on the novel)
Law 3 (per-field provenance and confidence; nothing claimed unmeasured)
Law 4 (the door is physics, not a habit of asking)
Law 5 (charter, state, history and proofs share this address)
